```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

res$results%>%
  group_by(Method, Time)%>%summarise(Mean_Est = mean(Est),
                               SD_Est = sd(Est))%>%
  filter(Method != "Standardization")%>%
  mutate(Est = sprintf("%s (%s)", round(Mean_Est,2), round(SD_Est,2)))%>%
  select(Method, Time, Est)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = Est, names_prefix = "Time ")%>%
  pander(caption = sprintf("Mean estimates for the different approaches based on %s simulations with %s patients in each simulation",
                           Nsim,
                           2*Narm) )

```


```{r}

truth <- res$truth%>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(
    
    A == "0" ~ "atnt",
    A == "1" ~ "att",
    TRUE ~ "ate"
    
  ))%>%mutate(Time = time)



res$results%>%left_join(truth%>%filter(Type == "att"))%>%
  group_by(Method, Time)%>%
  summarise(Bias = mean(Est - Eff),
            SD = sd(Est),
            MSE = mean( (Est - Eff)^2))%>%
  select(-MSE)%>%
  mutate(res = sprintf("B. %s / sd %s", round(Bias,2), round(SD,2)))%>%
  
  select(Method, Time, res)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = res, names_prefix = "Time ")%>%
  pander(caption = sprintf("Bias and SD for the different approaches based on %s simulations with %s patients in each arm. ATT was targeted",
                           Nsim,
                           Narm ), 
         split.table = Inf)

```

```{r}

plotexpfun <- function(fsimlist, width = 0.01){
  
  temp <- expand_grid(
    expand.grid(A = c(0,1),
              X = c(-1,0,1))%>%
    mutate(ID = row_number()),
  time = 1:fsimlist$tmeas)
    
temp$c_ps <- as.numeric(model.matrix(fsimlist$c_form, temp)[,-1]%*%fsimlist$c_coef)
temp$d_ps <- as.numeric(model.matrix(fsimlist$d_form, temp)[,-1]%*%fsimlist$d_coef)

temp$y <- as.numeric(model.matrix(fsimlist$y_form, temp)%*%c(0,fsimlist$y_coef))

temp$chaz <- exp(temp$c_ps)*fsimlist$c_basehaz
temp$dhaz <- exp(temp$d_ps)*fsimlist$d_basehaz



plottemp <- expand_grid(time = seq(0,fsimlist$tmeas, by = width),
                        temp%>%filter(time == 1)%>%select(-time, -y))%>%mutate(C = exp(-chaz*time),
                                       D = exp(-dhaz*time))%>%left_join(temp%>%select(ID, time, y))

cplot <- ggplot(plottemp,  aes(time, C, color = factor(X)))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~ A,labeller = labeller( .cols = label_both))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Censoring - ignoring death")+
  ylim(c(0,1))

dplot <- ggplot(plottemp,  aes(time, D, color = factor(X)))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~ A,labeller = labeller( .cols = label_both))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Death - ignoring censoring")+
  ylim(c(0,1))

yplot <- ggplot(plottemp, aes(time, y, color = factor(X)))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~ A,labeller = labeller( .cols = label_both))+
  theme_bw()+
  ylab("X-conditional QoL while alive")

 cowplot::plot_grid(yplot, dplot, cplot, ncol = 1)
  
}



```



```{r, eval=FALSE}

sittabfun <- function(fsimlist, width = 0.01){
  #browser()
  expit <- function(x){ exp(x)/(1+exp(x))}
  logit <- function(x){ log(x/(1-x))}
  
  temp <- expand.grid(A = c(0,1),
              X = c(0,1))
  
pa0x1 <- expit(fsimlist$a_x_coef[1])
pa1x1 <- expit(sum(fsimlist$a_x_coef))

temp <- temp%>%mutate(PropBase = case_when(
  
  A == 1 & X == 1 ~ pa1x1,
  A == 1 & X == 0 ~ 1-pa1x1,
  A == 0 & X == 1 ~ pa0x1,
  A == 0 & X == 0 ~ 1-pa0x1
),
PropBaseTarget = case_when(
  
   X == 1 ~ pa1x1,
   X == 0 ~ 1-pa1x1,

))
    
temp$c_ps <- model.matrix(fsimlist$c_form, temp)[,-1]%*%fsimlist$c_coef
temp$d_ps <- model.matrix(fsimlist$d_form, temp)[,-1]%*%fsimlist$d_coef

temp$y <- as.numeric(model.matrix(fsimlist$y_form, temp)%*%c(0,fsimlist$y_coef))

temp$chaz <- exp(temp$c_ps)*fsimlist$c_basehaz
temp$dhaz <- exp(temp$d_ps)*fsimlist$d_basehaz


tab <- temp%>%mutate(haztot = chaz + dhaz,
                     Pobs = as.numeric(exp(-haztot)),
                     Pcensind = (chaz)*(1-Pobs)/haztot,
                     Pdeathind = (dhaz)*(1-Pobs)/haztot, 
                     Palive = as.numeric(exp(-dhaz)))%>%
  group_by(A)%>%
  mutate(PropObs = PropBase*Pobs/sum(PropBase*Pobs),
         PropAlive = PropBase*Palive/sum(PropBase*Palive))%>%
  select(A, X, y,PropBase, PropBaseTarget, PropObs, PropAlive, Pobs, Palive)%>%
  group_by(A)%>%
  mutate(y_avg_obs = sum(PropBase*Pobs*y)/sum(PropBase*Pobs),
         #y_avg_obs_test = sum(PropObs*y),
         y_avg_alive = sum(PropBase*Palive*y)/sum(PropBase*Palive),
         #y_avg_alive_test = sum(PropAlive*y),
         y_avg_target_alive = sum(PropBaseTarget*Palive*y)/sum(PropBaseTarget*Palive)
         )%>%arrange(A)%>%
  mutate(y_avg_obs = ifelse(row_number() == 1, y_avg_obs, NaN),
         y_avg_alive = ifelse(row_number() == 1, y_avg_alive, NaN),
         y_avg_target_alive = ifelse(row_number() == 1, y_avg_target_alive, NaN))

tab

}



```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
pander(sittabfun(simlist)%>%select(-Pobs, -Palive), split.table = Inf, missing = "", digits = 3,
       caption = "PropBase: proportion within A at baseline \n
                  PropBaseTarget: proportion at baseline in target population \n
                  PropObs: proportion among observed within A \n
                  PropObs: porpotion among alive within A (in reality unknonw due to censoring)")

```
